100% Client-Side Privacy Commitment

Unlike public JWT debuggers that send your authentication tokens and secret keys to external servers, this tool operates exclusively in browser memory using the native Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle). Zero network packets are transmitted. Your secrets and customer tokens never leave your local machine.
